# ByteVision Reelworks

## About
ByteVision Reelworks is a cinematic short-form video production company founded by Jabari Okoro, based in Memphis, Tennessee and serving clients in Atlanta, Georgia and nationally. We build high-impact branded visuals — reels, commercials, and campaign content — that make businesses look bigger, stronger, and more important. We don't just make content look good. We build visuals designed to change perception, stop the scroll, and position brands on a larger stage.

## Services and Pricing

- **Scroll-Stopper Reel — $200**: 8-second cinematic brand reel. Built to grab attention fast. Best for promos, social media, quick ads, and launches. Includes concept direction and premium visual presentation.
- **Cinematic Commercial — $1,200**: 30-second premium commercial. Built for stronger storytelling, authority, and a more polished brand presence. Best for businesses that want to look major. Includes concept development, visual storytelling, premium framing, and a stronger sales message.
- **Campaign Package — $3,000**: 3 high-impact branded spots. Built for sustained momentum and bigger brand positioning. Best for businesses, campaigns, or brands that want a full visual push. Includes multiple concepts, campaign-level creative direction, and rollout strategy guidance.

## What Makes Us Different
ByteVision Reelworks focuses on cinematic short-form visuals that make brands feel bigger, stronger, and more important. We do not just make content look good. We build visuals to change perception, stop the scroll, and help businesses look like they belong on a bigger stage. Every project — from the $200 reel to the $3,000 campaign — is produced with the same cinematic intention.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does a brand reel or video cost?**
ByteVision Reelworks offers three tiers: the Scroll-Stopper Reel at $200 (8-second cinematic reel), the Cinematic Commercial at $1,200 (30-second premium spot), and the Campaign Package at $3,000 (3 branded spots with rollout strategy). Call 901-546-1899 or visit bytevisionreelworks.com to get started.

**What is the difference between the $200 reel and the $1,200 commercial?**
The $200 Scroll-Stopper Reel is an 8-second cinematic clip built for fast attention — social media, promos, and launches. The $1,200 Cinematic Commercial is a 30-second premium spot built for deeper storytelling, stronger authority, and a more polished brand presence. Both are produced cinematically, but the commercial delivers more narrative and sales impact.

**How long does it take to receive my finished video?**
Turnaround time varies by project tier. Contact us at 901-546-1899 for current production timelines.

**Do you work with businesses outside of Memphis?**
Yes. ByteVision Reelworks serves clients nationally. We have a presence in Memphis, Tennessee and Atlanta, Georgia and take on remote and travel projects across the United States.

**What types of businesses do you work with?**
We work with local businesses, restaurants, service brands, real estate and funding companies, barbershops, beauty brands, event promoters, public figures, political campaigns, and any growing brand that wants to look more premium and get more attention.

**Can I use these videos on Instagram, TikTok, and paid ads?**
Yes. All ByteVision content is produced for multi-platform use including Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, and paid advertising campaigns.

**What is included in the $3,000 Campaign Package?**
The Campaign Package includes 3 high-impact branded spots, multiple creative concepts, campaign-level creative direction, and rollout strategy guidance. It is built for businesses, campaigns, or brands that want a full visual push and sustained brand momentum.

**What do I need to do to get started?**
Call 901-546-1899 or visit bytevisionreelworks.com. We'll discuss your brand, goals, and which production tier fits best.
